# ScrollManager isScrolling toggle launches colliding child VDOM flight

## Context

Captured during 2D big-data scroll benchmarking (`defect-note: src/grid/ScrollManager.mjs is wrong` in `MESSAGE:8cf6fe49-e406-4675-bbde-08d9db41499e`): on both scroll start (`ScrollManager#onContainerScroll`) and scroll end (`ScrollManager#onScrollEnd`), setting `body.isScrolling` before `me.syncGridBody()` launches an independent depth-1 VDOM flight on each grid body (`bodyStart`, `bodyEnd`, `body`) right before `View#syncBodies` calls `view.update()`.

- Live latest-open sweep: checked latest 20 open issues in `neomjs/neo` at `2026-10-26T14:09:53Z` (`#20114`..`#19139`); no equivalent found
- A2A in-flight claim sweep: checked latest 30 messages (`status: 'all'`) at `2026-10-26T14:09:48Z`; no overlapping claim found
- MC sweep: `"ScrollManager onContainerScroll isScrolling syncGridBody syncBodies ScrollFlightMerge 18439 18719"`, 6 results, no prior decision found (`#18439` / `#18719` fixed sparse pruning when a body update merges into an already-in-flight `View` update via `denseUpdate`, leaving the idle-`View` child-before-parent collision on scroll start and scroll end untouched)
- Own-assignment sweep: 0 open in `neomjs/neo`, none overlapping

## The Problem

When a grid begins scrolling from rest (`view.isVdomUpdating === false && view.needsVdomUpdate === false`) or settles in `ScrollManager#onScrollEnd` (150 ms after the last scroll event, when `view.isVdomUpdating === false`):

1. `ScrollManager#onContainerScroll` (`src/grid/ScrollManager.mjs:203-205`, `225-227`) and `ScrollManager#onScrollEnd` (`src/grid/ScrollManager.mjs:245-247`) assign `isScrolling = true` / `false` directly on `container.bodyStart`, `container.bodyEnd`, and `container.body` before calling `me.syncGridBody()`.
2. `Body#afterSetIsScrolling` (`src/grid/Body.mjs:526-529`) calls `this.toggleCls('neo-is-scrolling', value)`, which mutates `cls` non-silently and calls `body.update()`.
3. Furthermore, even if `isScrolling` is updated via `setSilent` (setting `body.needsVdomUpdate = true`), `View#syncBodies` (`src/grid/View.mjs:1252`) calls `_body.set({scrollLeft, scrollTop})` without `silent = true`; `Abstract#set` (`src/component/Abstract.mjs:532`) checks `if (!silent && me.needsVdomUpdate) return me.promiseUpdate()`, which immediately launches a depth-1 flight on `_body` before `_body.createViewData(true, force)` and `view.update()`.
4. Because `view.isVdomUpdating` and `view.needsVdomUpdate` are both `false` at that instant, `body.mergeIntoParentUpdate()` returns `false` and `body.executeVdomUpdate()` starts immediately at default `updateDepth = 1`, setting `body.isVdomUpdating = true` and registering `body.id` in `VDomUpdate.descendantInFlightMap.get(view.id)`.
5. Microseconds later in the same synchronous call stack, `View#syncBodies` (`src/grid/View.mjs:1240-1297`) proceeds:
   - `_body.createViewData(true, force)` hits `if (me.isVdomUpdating)` at `src/grid/Body.mjs:799`, aborts synchronous row projection, and defers `createViewData(true, force)` into `VDomUpdate.preUpdateMap`!
   - `view.update()` hits `view.isChildUpdating()` at `src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs:1400`, detects the in-flight `body` descendant, and parks `view.update()` in `VDomUpdate.postUpdateQueueMap` behind `body`'s depth-1 class-only flight!
6. As a result, the first scroll frame and `onScrollEnd` split into two serialized VDOM flights: a depth-1 flight carrying only `neo-is-scrolling` on `body` (0 row deltas), followed a full macrotask + worker round-trip later by the deferred `createViewData` and `view.update()` row repaint.

## The Architectural Reality

Design authority: `"The scroll repaints a row's subtree as one silent transaction, so the depth has to reach the cell CONTENTS, not the cell."` (`src/grid/View.mjs:1278-1279`)

- `Neo.grid.View#syncBodies` (`src/grid/View.mjs:1240-1297`) is the single VDOM transaction owner for scroll steps across `body`, `bodyStart`, and `bodyEnd`. It suppresses body-level `createViewData` during `scrollLeft`/`scrollTop`/`startIndex` updates (`_body.skipCreateViewData = true`), runs `_body.createViewData(true, force)` with `silent = true`, and ships `View` + all `Body` instances + all `Row` and `Cell` subtrees in one dense update (`me.updateDepth = ROW_DISTANCE + me.maxCellDepth`, `me.denseUpdate = true`).
- When `ScrollManager#onContainerScroll` and `ScrollManager#onScrollEnd` update `isScrolling` via `setSilent({isScrolling: true})` / `setSilent({isScrolling: false})` on `bodyStart`, `bodyEnd`, and `body`, and `View#syncBodies` updates `scrollLeft`/`scrollTop` via `_body.setSilent({scrollLeft, scrollTop})`:
  - `Abstract#setSilent` (`src/component/Abstract.mjs:549-553`) sets `silentVdomUpdate = true` around `super.set(...)`.
  - `Body#afterSetIsScrolling` still runs synchronously, updating `cls` / `vdom.cls` via `toggleCls('neo-is-scrolling', value)` and firing `isScrollingChange` for listeners (`Neo.grid.plugin.AnimateRows`), while `VdomLifecycle#updateVdom` (`src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs:1375`) records `body.needsVdomUpdate = true` without launching a colliding depth-1 flight on `body`.
  - Immediately afterward, `me.syncGridBody()` -> `View#syncBodies` updates `scrollLeft`/`scrollTop` silently, executes `_body.createViewData(true, force)` synchronously (`body.isVdomUpdating === false`), and ships both the `neo-is-scrolling` class delta on every body and the repainted rows in a single `view.update()` batch (clearing `body._needsVdomUpdate = false` via `Container#afterSetNeedsVdomUpdate`).

## The Fix

1. In `src/grid/ScrollManager.mjs`:
   - Add `#setBodyScrolling(isScrolling)` and call it in `onContainerScroll` (both vertical and horizontal branches) and `onScrollEnd` to update `isScrolling` on `container.bodyStart`, `container.bodyEnd`, and `container.body` via `setSilent({isScrolling})` (with direct assignment fallback for plain-object unit test doubles).
2. In `src/grid/View.mjs`:
   - In `syncBodies`, change `_body.set({scrollLeft, scrollTop})` to `_body.setSilent({scrollLeft, scrollTop})` so `Abstract#set` does not flush a pre-existing `_body.needsVdomUpdate` as a depth-1 `_body.promiseUpdate()` flight ahead of `me.update()`.
3. In `test/playwright/unit/grid/ScrollFlightMerge.spec.mjs`:
   - Add a unit test verifying that `scrollManager.onContainerScroll` (from rest) and `scrollManager.onScrollEnd` do not launch a colliding depth-1 `body` flight ahead of `View#syncBodies`, that `body.createViewData` runs synchronously during `onContainerScroll` rather than deferring into `VDomUpdate.preUpdateMap`, and that the `neo-is-scrolling` class delta and row updates ship together in the single `View` flight.

## Decision Record impact

`none`

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `ScrollManager#onContainerScroll` (vertical and horizontal branches) and `ScrollManager#onScrollEnd` set `isScrolling` via `setSilent` on `bodyStart`, `bodyEnd`, and `body`, and `View#syncBodies` uses `_body.setSilent({scrollLeft, scrollTop})`.
- [x] Starting a scroll via `scrollManager.onContainerScroll` when `view` is idle (`view.isVdomUpdating === false`) does not set `body.isVdomUpdating = true` before `view.syncBodies()`, executes `body.createViewData` synchronously without deferring to `VDomUpdate.preUpdateMap`, and ships `neo-is-scrolling` and repainted rows in a single `View` VDOM batch.
- [x] `scrollManager.onScrollEnd` removes `neo-is-scrolling` and syncs bodies in a single `View` VDOM batch without child-update collision.
- [x] Existing `test/playwright/unit/grid/ScrollFlightMerge.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/unit/grid/AnimateRowsSteps.spec.mjs` pass.

## Out of Scope

- Changing `Body#afterSetIsScrolling` for direct non-scroll callers (`body.isScrolling = true`).
- Modifying `VdomLifecycle` or `VDomUpdate` merge/collision semantics (`#18439` / `#18719`).

## Avoided Traps

- **Making `Body#afterSetIsScrolling` unconditionally silent:** External callers or unit tests that set `body.isScrolling = true` without calling `View#syncBodies` (`test/playwright/unit/grid/AnimateRowsSteps.spec.mjs:178`) rely on `Body#afterSetIsScrolling` triggering a body update when no `View#syncBodies` follows. Using `setSilent({isScrolling})` in `ScrollManager` scopes silence to the exact sites that immediately call `me.syncGridBody()`.
